retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast 1970s album layout featuring a red top banner, a large airbrushed central portrait, and a right-aligned tracklist.
triggerTerms: red header with bold white text

recipe.visualDefinition: A vibrant 1970s-style album cover characterized by a solid red top header containing bold sans-serif text, a central airbrushed portrait of a man that blends into a montage of smaller figures (singers and athletes), and a clean white background on the right side for a multi-colored tracklist.
coreVisualRelationships: Red header bar anchoring the top third of the composition
Large central face acting as the primary visual focus
Smaller action figures integrated into the hair and cheek of the main portrait
Right-aligned text block balancing the left-heavy illustration
coreInvariants: Airbrushed illustrative style with soft gradients
High-contrast color blocking between red, white, and blue

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A large-scale male face occupies the center and bottom-left, with smaller figures nested within its silhouette.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The solid red header bar at the top provides a heavy horizontal anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the bold white numbers in the header, move down to the stylized title, then follow the portrait's gaze toward the tracklist on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant white space on the right side allows the tracklist to remain legible against the complex illustration.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Vibrant Red (Header and accents in illustration)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Royal Blue (Title outline and secondary text)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the header and title, with softer, desaturated tones in the airbrushed portrait skin tones.

letterConstructionRules: Header text uses ultra-bold, condensed sans-serif forms
Main title features slanted, interlocking characters with sharp terminals
Tracklist uses a clean, legible sans-serif with tight leading
characterSpecificRedesigns: Title letters feature a heavy blue outline and white fill with internal horizontal shearing
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Bold, blocky sans-serif for information paired with a stylized, outlined display face for the title.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed feel of the header text.
Captures the 70s energy of the main title.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create an airbrushed montage illustration on a white background. Include a large male face in the center-bottom, with smaller figures of singers and soccer players blended into the hair and facial features using soft red and purple gradients. Add a solid red bar across the top 20% of the frame.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold white condensed sans-serif text in the red header. Place a large, blue-outlined white display title centered below the header. Add a right-aligned list of text in alternating red and blue colors on the right side of the image.

verificationChecks: Is the header bar solid red?
Is the title outlined in blue?
Is the illustration airbrushed in style?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the red header is a flat, solid color.
Check that the airbrushing has soft, feathered edges.
Verify the title has a distinct blue outline.
Confirm the tracklist is legible and properly aligned.
recipe.reuseFormula: Red Header + Airbrushed Montage + Outlined Display Title + Right-Aligned List
